central_question: How can mechanical training reorganize a polymer network into a persistent, stronger configuration?
claims_and_limits: Adapt-ring networks combine sparsely crosslinked PEG with dense reconfigurable alpha-cyclodextrin crystalline domains.
Mechanical training improves several measured properties by up to an order of magnitude in specific comparisons, not every property of every sample at once.
The trained configuration can be reset by solvent-induced domain reformation; industrial lifetime and repeated reset behavior are not established.
C.K. and D.Z. disclose pending patent applications.

visual.shared_motif: Warm amber transparent polymer strip with conceptual clustered rings that fragment and redistribute under load; separate solvent reset scene.
visual.status: Conceptual material visualization, not a micrograph or molecular structure diagram.
